headlines.text: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq slide as Nvidia tumbles ahead of earnings and Anthropic's IPO looms
Treasury Secretary Bessent gives Nvidia's board 10 days to explain 'seemingly illicit' chip sales to China, calls for an outside CEO hire
A 'war room' pushing to reinstate Jensen Huang at Nvidia faces opposition from Bessent and congressional probes
Anthropic's IPO set to price Wednesday at $70-$78 a share, with Nasdaq trading under 'ANT' starting Nov. 19 at up to a $1.4 trillion valuation
Fed's October meeting minutes, due out Wednesday, expected to show officials divided and doubtful of a December rate cut
